# Code of conduct

Down Lane Motion is for bowlers of every level, style and opinion. Everyone taking part in this
repo - issues, discussions and comments - is expected to help keep it welcoming.

## Expected

- Be respectful, including when you disagree. People bowl different styles, on different
  conditions, and like different balls; there's rarely one right answer.
- Assume good intent, and ask before assuming someone meant harm.
- Keep to the topic of the issue or discussion you're in.
- Welcome newcomers. Everyone was new to layouts and differentials once.

## Not acceptable

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks, in public or in private.
- Discriminatory language or jokes of any kind.
- Posting someone else's private information.
- Spam, advertising, or repeated off-topic posts.
- Anything else that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a friendly, public space.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove comments, lock conversations, and block people from the repo
for behavior that breaks this code, and don't have to give notice first.

To report something, use **Report content** from the `...` menu on the comment or issue.

This code is based on the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/),
version 2.1.
